debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross, new 20-day highs, and three white soldiers pattern establish structural bullish alignment with price above key EMAs, supported by contrarian buy signal amid extreme fear conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Post-FOMC elevated VIX (27.66), negative CMF divergence, weak ADX trend confirmation, extreme 15x volume spike suggesting climactic move, and unfavourable macro environment create excessive entry risk despite bullish technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Single technical strategy (golden cross + bullish pattern) insufficient to overcome post-FOMC macro headwinds, elevated VIX volatility, negative CMF divergence, and weak trend confirmation.
